units.source_text: 明石姬在这大堰邸内，越是住得长久，越是觉得凄凉。

en.t: The longer Lady Akashi lived in this Oi residence, the more desolate she felt.
Even in ordinary quiet times, her worries and sorrows kept increasing.

units.source_text: 何况与难得降临的源氏内大臣结了痛苦的不解之缘，见面时只是匆匆一叙，反而徒增悲叹。

en.t: All the more so because she had formed a painful and inescapable bond with the Minister Genji, who so rarely came to visit; when they met, they could only speak briefly and hurriedly, which merely deepened her grief.

units.source_text: 因此源氏内大臣只得尽心竭力地抚慰她。

en.t: For that reason, the Minister Genji could only devote all his heart and strength to comforting her.

units.source_text: 透过异常繁茂的树木，远远望见大堰河鸬鹚船的篝灯明灭，火光反映在池塘里，好像点点流萤。

en.t: Through the unusually dense trees, the torchlights of the cormorant boats on the Oi River could be seen flickering in the distance, and their firelight reflected in the pond like scattered drifting fireflies.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“此种住宅的情景，若非在明石浦看惯，看了定然觉得稀奇。”

en.t: The Minister Genji said, "If one had not grown used to such scenes of a dwelling at Akashi Bay, one would certainly find this sight unusual."
